tools.name: search_deals

tools.name: get_offer
tools.description: The full evidence record for one offer: exact product identity, price and its conditions, the verification ledger, freshness, price context and recent changes.

tools.name: check_eligibility
tools.description: Evaluate whether a shopper can get an offer’s price, given what you know about them: memberships, location, app or store purchase, first order, coupon clipping, Subscribe & Save and order total. Anything not supplied stays unknown and makes the verdict "uncertain" rather than "eligible".

tools.name: verify_offer
tools.description: Request a fresh check of the offer at the retailer, and report exactly what could and could not be confirmed. request_status says whether a check was made (completed, attempted_no_result, cached, in_progress, refused); verification_established is true only when a completed check read a price. tools.name: get_price_context
tools.description: How the offer’s price compares with independent checks of the same exact product, and how strong that comparison is (coverage: strong, limited or none). Repeat the coverage alongside any conclusion.

tools.name: get_changes
tools.description: Offers updated, verified or withdrawn since a cursor (or a time).
